issue.title: [A+] Composite grades initiative tracker (Architecture / Product / Tests / Process)
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Tracking issue for closing the four **A+ composite grade** gaps (≥9.5) from the Aug 2026 scorecard (Then = May 7 handover; Now = Aug 24).

| Dimension | Now | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Architecture | A− 8.7 | A+ ≥9.5 |
| Ship-ready product | B− 6.5 | A+ ≥9.5 |
| Test safety net | B+ 8.0 | A+ ≥9.5 |
| Process / CI | A− 8.6 | A+ ≥9.5 |

Child tickets are filed separately (one PR each). This issue does **not** ship code.

**Status (2026-08-25):** Agent queue + manual items complete — 12 open PRs awaiting merge (engineering-only, no QA). Manual #377 / #378 closed Done. See [#365#issuecomment-5417472678](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/365#issuecomment-5417472678).

## Child tickets

### Architecture
- [x] #366 — ESLint layer boundary bans (A1) — PR #382
- [x] #367 — CI-enforce architecture-guard (A2) — PR #383
- [x] #368 — Audit `@react-navigation` dependencies (A3) — PR #384

### Tests
- [x] #369 — `sync.ts` step unit tests (T1) — merged #385
- [x] #370 — `useVerseAudio` unit tests (T3a) — PR #386
- [x] #371 — `useRecordingEngine` unit tests (T3b) — PR #388
- [x] #372 — Prepare Offline service-layer tests (T4) — PR #389
- [x] #373 — Account / sync hook unit tests (T5) — PR #390

### Product
- [x] #374 — Resolve `sync.switchUser` stub (P2) — PR #391
- [ ] #235 — Source audio dock (P1 existing — do not duplicate)
- [x] #375 — Shared-device multi-account nightly QA script (P4) — PR #395
- [ ] P3 — P0/P1 field-loop burn-down = **existing board work** (not a new feature ticket)

### Process / CI
- [x] #376 — Snapshot required branch-protection checks (C1) — PR #392
- [x] #377 — QA handoff Status token reliability (C2) — manual, closed Done
- [x] #378 — In QA column hygiene proposal (C3) — manual, closed Done
- [x] #379 — Align `format` vs `format:check` globs (C4) — PR #393
- [x] #380 — Dependabot one-at-a-time + doctor checklist (C5) — PR #394
- [x] #330 — Close as superseded per `docs/guides/qa-process.md` (do not implement merge-blocking QA gate)

## Separation rules

- **Do not combine** #366+#367 (lint rules vs CI guard script).
- **Do not combine** #370+#371 (different hooks, separate PRs).
- **Do not fold** #374 into #369 (product behavior vs sync step tests).
- **Do not** invent a vague “P0 burn-down” mega-PR — use existing Project 4 cards.
- #378 requires an **approved named change set** before any board Status edits (`docs/guides/project-board.md`).
- Optional further split: #372 can split by module if review size grows; #373 can split per hook if needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] All child tickets exist, on Project 4, and are linked from this body
- [ ] When children complete, re-score the A+ canvas with dated proof
- [ ] No child merges with incomplete AC unless ticket-level waiver + follow-up issue

## Links

- Board: [Fluent Mobile Board (Project 4, view 9)](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9)
- Docs: `docs/guides/qa-process.md`, `docs/ci.md`, `.cursor/rules/architecture.mdc`
